fusions.name: Tongue Lash
fusions.desc: Snaps a lash 5 tiles long ahead of you that holds for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward, dealing 8 damage, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapped Up
fusions.desc: Strikes only a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up, and deals 8 damage.

fusions.name: Springback Barrier
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 24 damage for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled Reserve
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they spend at once and you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
